queueHowItWorksIntro: The queue has three stages: get ready, wait at the door, and enter now.
queueHowItWorksRevisitBody: Review the three queue stages whenever you need a reminder.
queueHowItWorksPrepareBody:
This is a heads-up, not a call to go to any room yet.

Use this time to gather your team, prepare any services you need, and get your presentation materials ready. We’ll tell you when it’s time to move.
queueHowItWorksDoorBody:
Now it’s time to head to your room. We ask you to wait at the door so the next presentation can start as soon as the jury is ready.

How many teams wait in this buffer zone depends on the judging setup and the number of rooms sharing the queue. Stay outside the room until you’re explicitly called in.
queueHowItWorksDoorNote: Near the top of another queue? No action needed: you won’t be called into another room while you wait here.
queueHowItWorksEnterBody:
This is your moment. The jury may send this alert or step out to call you in.

When you get a clear instruction to enter, go for it. It’s your turn to present. You’ve got this!
